title: Unhappy
text: Unhappy. 2 stars just because it’s easy to clean.  Cannot fill the round tray without it becoming one big chunk of ice.  Tried many times.  You can press the two halves together as hard as you can but the water will still lift the top half off.  Also very messy to use.  I don’t recommend.
